basis: Corrected evidence after scope repair. Supersedes 735bd7ab06ae2caf72e37447d207dec62c17932ee1684c4c393d8ace07684c52 (SUPERSEDED_SCOPE_BOUNDARY_MISALIGNMENT).

accepted_scanner_evidence.reproducibility: two independent fresh executions, identical logical hash, identical preflight hash, identical zone logical rows hash (REPRODUCIBILITY.json)

artifact_sha256: see ARTIFACT_SHA256.json (P-01/P-02 reviews, reconciliation, method challenge, anomaly audit, corrected evidence package)

frozen_reviews.note: Reviews, reconciliation and challenge were produced against the superseded evidence; the scope-repair audit shows every reviewed quantity and classification is unchanged on the corrected cohort except formation counts (-29) and orphan counts (+1/+2).

canonical_observations: 381,498 lawful FVG formations across 7 native XAUUSD strata (15s/30s/1m/5m/15m/1h/4h) inside the frozen development window; cross-scale object identity prohibited.
Median formation-to-first-touch is 2 native bars at every stratum; median formation-to-fill is 7/7/7/7/8/8/5 native bars (15s..4h).

Rapid lifecycle body + materially long-lived right tail (p95 fill in hundreds of native bars at fine/mid strata); tail estimates are increasingly limited by administrative right censoring at coarser strata (censoring 0.45% at 15s rising to 15.57% at 4h).

fill_rate + right_censored_rate = 1 by scanner construction (accounting complement); censoring rises materially with native scale and coarse-scale fill fractions are window-censored lower bounds, not lifetime probabilities.
Bullish formation share descriptively rises with native scale (51.0% at 15s to 60.5% at 4h): OBSERVED, not generalized, not confirmed.

Raw prospective median returns are positive in 21/21 stratum-horizon cells; direction-adjusted medians are 18 negative / 1 zero (15s h1 exactly 0.0; the serialized -0.0 is a sign-bit artifact) / 2 positive (1h h3 +0.85 bps n=523; 4h h5 +12.51 bps n=167).
Event-level availability delays are small in the distribution body (touch p50 92-119 ms, fill p50 85-115 ms at every stratum; p95 0.34-1.63 s) but can have large session-gap tails (max ~2.1 days).

resolved_anomalies.name: fill without recorded first touch
resolved_anomalies.observation: 1,010 in-window formed zones filled without an emitted first-touch event (682/213/81/20/10/4/0).
resolved_anomalies.explanation: Linked producer semantics permit a gap-through/far-edge fill without overlap: FIRST TOUCH = bar range overlaps the active zone; FILL = bullish bar low <= lower far edge / bearish bar high >= upper far edge, independent of the overlap predicate.
resolved_anomalies.note: The reconciliation premise 'a filling bar necessarily overlaps the zone' was false and is removed from the canonical record. FIRST_TOUCH E1B cohort excludes gap-through fills (first_touch_observed=false), never imputed.

resolved_anomalies.name: orphan lifecycle events
resolved_anomalies.observation: 536 orphan lifecycle events (178 touch / 358 fill) on the corrected cohort.
resolved_anomalies.explanation: Detector state whose formation predates the development cohort boundary; every orphan zone was detected strictly before its stratum's first lawful in-window formation (detection window 2025-07-22 .. 2025-07-31T16:15:00Z, two events exactly at the boundary instant).
resolved_anomalies.note: Excluded from in-window formed-zone cohorts; not missing formations.

resolved_anomalies.name: development view start-boundary misalignment
resolved_anomalies.observation: The superseded evidence was generated from a view beginning 2025-07-31T16:00:00Z instead of the frozen 16:15:00Z scope boundary (29 pre-boundary formations, pre-boundary preflight stream).
resolved_anomalies.explanation: View builder implemented only the end-exclusive filter; repaired and re-materialized per director ruling.

'1h has strongest clock dependence' - produced by comparing separate marginal quantiles rather than paired per-event delays; rejected.

P-01 '19/21 negative' direction-adjusted medians - corrected to 18 negative / 1 zero / 2 positive against the committed results.
Anomaly interpretation of A1 (unexplained/serialization defect) - does not survive; the observation does.
Orphans as missing formations - rejected (left-truncated pre-development state).
e1b_requirements: One E1B stage-anchor extension with two anchors: FIRST_TOUCH (required) and FILL (approved, second priority).

FIRST_TOUCH cohort rule: formation -> actual emitted fvg_first_touch -> cohort. Gap-through fills with first_touch_observed=false are NOT imputed as touch and are excluded from the first-touch anchor cohort.
FILL cohort: all lawful fvg_filled events, stratified by first_touch_observed true/false.
FIRST_TOUCH E1B is BLOCKED_PENDING_MEASUREMENT_CONTRACT: the measurement contract (touch-cohort denominator, gap-through handling, anchor clock) must be frozen before launch.

Tail reporting: add p99, max, censor-aware unconditional quantile reporting, and a 'max identifiable unconditional quantile = 1 - censor fraction' line per stratum. No large survival-analysis subsystem.
Paired per-event information-delay distributions (touch/fill available_time - event time) with the anchor clock declared.
question_generator_candidates: Direction-adjusted median pattern (18/1/2) as DESCRIPTIVE_DIRECTIONAL_ASYMMETRY requiring a formal drift-aware null test.
Bullish formation-share gradient with native scale: development-window drift vs real asymmetry (drift-controlled null).
first_touch_observed true/false stratification at the FILL anchor.
must_not_claim: No edge/alpha/profitability/strategy/predictive-advantage claims (E1 is locked phenotype; nothing tested; confirmation LOCKED).
Fill fraction is not a hazard or lifetime probability (window censoring + accounting complement).
The negative direction-adjusted medians are not a tradable reversal effect (no null test run).
4h h5 +12.5 bps and 1h h3 are small-sample medians, not established sign reversals.
Strata are not interchangeable; no pooling; no cross-scale zone identity.
Higher-timeframe FVGs are not established as structurally bullish.
No clock-dependence claims from mixed marginal quantiles.
Orphans are not missing formations; A1 cases are not an unexplained anomaly.
